Plan your team kit

A CLEAR PLAN FOR YOUR CLUB

TEAM ORDERS.
YOUR QUESTIONS.

What can our team request?

Use the brief for custom jerseys, full teamwear, shared equipment or a combination. List the sport, quantities and any preferences so the store can discuss suitable options.

What details should we prepare?

Include a team contact, club name, player count, sizes, colours, names, numbers and your target date. Add a budget in the notes if you have one.

Is there a minimum order quantity?

Minimum quantities depend on the items and customisation. Record your actual requirements and confirm quantities, final prices and availability with the store.

Can we combine sizes and player numbers?

Add your size breakdown and individual names or numbers in the notes. Confirm the final artwork, sizing and quantities with the store before production.

Does the form place or pay for an order?

No. This frontend form creates a downloadable team-order brief. It sends nothing and takes no payment. Share the brief with the store to discuss a quotation.

How far ahead should we plan?

Include your match or event date in the brief. Ask the store to confirm lead times before committing to a schedule, especially for customised teamwear.
